statusDetail: Cloudflare managed security verification remained at “Just a moment…” after a fresh headless Chrome load and a 15-second wait, so the origin site, its representative routes, and its real user flows could not be reached.

page.notes: Only Cloudflare’s managed challenge was observable. The origin site profile could not be established.

artifacts.caption: Initial desktop capture showing the Cloudflare security-verification interstitial.
Capture after a 15-second wait; the Cloudflare interstitial still blocks the origin.
Rendered DOM and CSS belong to the Cloudflare challenge page rather than the origin site.
Recon probe returned title “Just a moment...” and only Cloudflare challenge content.
Follow-up probe confirms the browser remained on the Cloudflare verification page after 15 seconds.
robots.txt was reachable, but sitemap.xml returned a 403 Cloudflare challenge instead of a sitemap.
